sara_devex: Quick note — Python quickstart in docs has a broken copy-paste and a dead link to the pip package. When running the async snippet I get AttributeError: 'AsyncClient' object has no attribute 'chat'.

jonathan_docs: Ugh. Can you paste the exact snippet and the link you followed?

sara_devex: Sure — from the README:
```python
from redwood import AsyncClient
client = AsyncClient()
resp = await client.chat.create(messages=[{"role":"user","content":"hello"}])
print(resp.output_text)
```
Link points to https://pypi.org/project/redwood-sdk (404). Stack trace: `AttributeError: 'AsyncClient' object has no attribute 'chat'`

liam_sdk: Thanks. This is caused by a recent API rename — async client exposes `responses` and `embeddings`, but the docs still show `chat` like the sync client. We'll push a quick docs PR. The runtime API hasn't changed, it's just the SDK parity gap between versions.

jonathan_docs: Ah that explains it. Can someone add a note about upgrading or pinning to the previous SDK while we fix the snippet?

alice_infra: CI also caught this — https://ci.internal/redwood/ops/board/job/582 failed for `test_docs_snippets::test_py_quickstart` with the same AttributeError. Marked failing tests as flaky.

liam_sdk: Workaround for users: either use the sync Client API or use the correct async call:
```python
from redwood import AsyncClient
client = AsyncClient()
resp = await client.responses.create(input=[{"role":"user","content":"hello"}])
print(resp.output_text)
```
Or pin older version: `pip install redwood-sdk==0.9.2` until we release a compatibility patch.

maria_support: Filing a support KB entry with workaround and pointing to the PR once merged.

sara_devex: I'm opening docs PR now — #2147. Will update the pip link and the snippet to show both sync and async examples plus a one-liner note about package name change.

jonathan_docs: Thanks. Can you also add a short unit test that runs the snippet against a fake/fixture client so CI catches regressions?

liam_sdk: Adding test in the SDK repo and I'll include a compatibility layer that logs a deprecation warning when `chat` is accessed on AsyncClient. Targeting patch release today.

jonathan_docs: Great. Assigning to @liam_sdk and @sara_devex. :thumbsup:

ci-bot: Build #582 rerun queued once PR 2147 merges.

sara_devex: I'll follow up here after merge. Thanks everyone. :party:
